names := ["Sato", "Suzuki", "Takahashi", "Tanaka", "Ito", "Watanabe"]
usages := [85, 120, 254, 300, 438, 176]
total := 0
for name := names[], usage := usages[]
    bill := 900
    if usage <= 120
        bill += usage * 30
    elif usage <= 300
        bill += 120 * 30 + (usage - 120) * 36
    else
        bill += 120 * 30 + 180 * 36 + (usage - 300) * 40
    total += bill
    println("{name}: {usage} kWh, {bill} yen")
println("total: {total} yen")
